name: Scenario 3: Workspace Sync Control & Popover Regression Fixture

mockData.isolationGuarantee: Local isolated in-memory test data only. No IndexedDB access, no network sync, no external timers.

portalThemeEscape.defect: routeThemeConfig.ts marks /notes as dark mode, but data-theme was attached only to DashboardShell (#dashboard-shell) while document.documentElement remained in light mode. Portals mounted into document.body escape DashboardShell and render with light theme background (bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 renders white instead of dark zinc).
portalThemeEscape.targetContract: Single source of truth on <html> via documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark') and #ud-portal-root wrapper inheriting route theme.

unsupportedAnimationClasses.defect: WorkspaceSyncControl.tsx:274 specifies 'animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2' on error toast. These classes belong to tailwindcss-animate plugin which is not present in Tailwind v4 configuration; zero CSS rules are generated in compiled stylesheet.
unsupportedAnimationClasses.baselineEffect: Animations silently fail to compile or apply
unsupportedAnimationClasses.targetContract: Use supported Tailwind v4 animations or Framer Motion; eliminate phantom plugin classes.

undefinedRadiusFullToken.defect: NotesSaveStatus.module.css:53 specifies border-radius: var(--radius-full). In tokens.css, --radius-full does not exist; the repository defines --radius-pill: 999px instead. The variable evaluates to invalid/initial, leaving the badge without fully rounded pill corners.
undefinedRadiusFullToken.targetContract: Define compatibility alias --radius-full: var(--radius-pill); in tokens.css and migrate callers.
